text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Rrrrgh... Aaaaaah, I was so close!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I thought for sure I coulda held on a little longer! And I made my move at the perfect time too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter what I say, it won't a
change a
thing. Congrats, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're as strong as I imagined. But that
doesn't
mean you're winning the next
one, hear?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna really bring the
heat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! This isn't over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The next time we face each other,
neither one of
us shall hold back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Our competition will be fierce, just as
today's was!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With the Kikuka Sho finished, there is
little left to
do this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Soon after we welcome in the new year,
it will be
time for—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My number one objective... I will show
everyone
the culmination of all my hard
work!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen's fiery determination is

palpable, her eyes fixed firmly on what
lies
ahead.
